how_it_was_made: One LoRA run with a pointer head trained from scratch on data/train.jsonl; the checkpoint was chosen on the calibration split and the temperature fitted there.

recipe.precision: bf16 backbone, fp32 LoRA and pointer head, gradient checkpointing
recipe.loss: cross-entropy over each question's options (soft-target cross-entropy where a record gives a target distribution), per-question weights; a record's questions are averaged and every record weighs the same, its augmented variants sharing its weight

augmentation.not_augmented: soft targets, and questions that already offer a none/other option

selection: highest accuracy on a fixed 2001-question sample of the calibration split, lower NLL breaks ties; fixed before training

temperature.fit: negative log-likelihood on the calibration split (43309 questions, 10% of the training mix, disjoint from train and test); that split is used only to fit T and choose the checkpoint; 1.0 = raw logits
